newsitem.title: USA: MBIA merges units, Gourd to head new group.
newsitem.headline: MBIA merges units, Gourd to head new group.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp., a unit of Armonk, N.Y.-based MBIA Inc., said Wednesday it combined its secondary market insurance group and market research department into one unit headed up by Henri Gourd.

Gourd, who was promoted to the newly created post of managing director of the Market Research/Secondary Market Department, replaced Gary Karvelis and Thomas Landers, who previously headed up secondary market operations and market research, respectively.
Karvelis and Landers "left the company to pursue other interests," according to a statement.
An MBIA spokesman said the moves were part of MBIA's "continuing effort to increase our efficiency and competitive position."
Gourd was most recently a vice presdient and manager in MBIA's insured portfolio management department.

In other moves, Francie Heller, executive vice president of MBIA's Municipal Investors Service Corp. unit, will replace Leon Karvelis, formerly the president of that subsidiary, who has also left the firm.
